forbiddenPublicText.message: consumer-specific branding must not define the JinguiSSL public narrative
use the evidence-based capability status vocabulary instead of a blanket Stable label

forbiddenPublicText.pattern: ML-KEM 的标准化尚未关闭
forbiddenPublicText.message: ML-KEM is standardized; describe the actual implementation gap instead

forbiddenPublicText.pattern: 安全的(错误处理|引擎解析)版本|全面的 AES 启动自检|验证完整证书链
forbiddenPublicText.message: non-throwing helpers and local checks must not imply broader security or completeness

capabilities.label: Facade metadata and Contract errors
capabilities.limits: 兼容映射不应成为仓库身份；错误稳定性仍服从具体 API。

capabilities.label: Digest / HMAC / HKDF facade
capabilities.limits: MD5/SHA-1 仅兼容；无外部认证。

capabilities.label: ChaCha20 / Poly1305 facade
capabilities.proof: RFC vectors, roundtrip and invalid-input tests
capabilities.limits: 无外部认证或跨平台加速承诺。

capabilities.label: X25519 facade
capabilities.summary: Key pair、公钥派生、key agreement request/result/outcome。
capabilities.proof: key agreement, cloning, invalid-input and all-zero tests
capabilities.limits: 继承 Core 的恒定时间非认证边界。

capabilities.label: X.509 / PEM / HTTP TLS material
capabilities.summary: 证书链、pin、客户端信任材料与服务端证书/私钥输入整理。
capabilities.proof: HTTP startup material and verified-session tests
capabilities.limits: 不是完整 WebPKI、原生系统信任库或浏览器级 HTTPS 证明。

capabilities.label: AES backend readiness
capabilities.summary: AES backend 探测、引擎选择与启动期 readiness。
capabilities.limits: 探测结果不是硬件加速认证或生产安全认证。

capabilities.label: SSH startup bundle
capabilities.summary: KEX 输入、主机验证策略与库级启动 request/bundle。
capabilities.proof: SSH startup bundle and HTTP/SSH readiness tests
capabilities.limits: 不声明外部 SSH client/server 互操作或完整会话产品。

capabilities.label: Provider readiness and smoke gates
capabilities.summary: Provider capability、self-check、smoke、错误归一化与降级建议。
capabilities.proof: provider gate, self-check and smoke tests
capabilities.limits: 部分 smoke fixture 是 metadata/precheck 证明，不等同于 live network handshake。

capabilities.label: ECC capability probe
capabilities.summary: 曲线、ECDSA/ECDH 可用性与 policy 信息探测。
capabilities.limits: 不是 ECC 签名/协商操作 facade，也不升级 Core 时序边界。

capabilities.label: Ed25519 capability probe
capabilities.summary: Ed25519 key/signature shape 与可用性探测。
capabilities.limits: 不是签名操作 facade；继承 Core 的私钥时序非认证边界。

capabilities.label: RSA capability probe
capabilities.summary: RSA key size、signature scheme 与 hash policy 探测。
capabilities.limits: 不是 RSA 私钥操作 facade；无恒定时间认证。

capabilities.label: SM3 / SM4 capability probe
capabilities.summary: SM3/SM4 availability 与参数形状探测。
capabilities.limits: 不是完整 SM3/SM4 operation facade，不声明商密认证。

capabilities.label: KEM profile placeholder
capabilities.summary: KEM availability/profile metadata for future routing.
capabilities.limits: 当前不是 ML-KEM/PQC 实现；传统 RSA-KEM/ECDH-KEM 也不等于量子安全。

capabilities.label: QUIC v1/v2 protection facade
capabilities.summary: Initial key derivation、显式 AEAD、Header Protection 与 Retry integrity。
capabilities.proof: RFC 9001 vectors, mismatch rejection, standalone consumer and full tests
capabilities.limits: 仅为 QUIC 密码/包保护接口；不声明 QUIC transport、HTTP/3 或网络互操作完成。

capabilities.label: TLS session cache
capabilities.summary: 有限容量 cache、ticket/session identity 与 early-data replay helper。
capabilities.proof: cache eviction, identity and replay tests
capabilities.limits: 库内缓存构件；不声明分布式、持久化或跨进程会话恢复。

capabilities.label: TLS cipher-suite, PSK and server-handshake contracts
capabilities.summary: Cipher suite、PSK DTO 与服务端握手输入/输出 contract。
capabilities.limits: 配置/DTO 与局部握手构件，不等同于完整 live TLS 产品。

capabilities.label: Incremental TLS 1.3 live runtime
capabilities.summary: Caller-owned transport 上的增量 client/server handshake、record 输入输出与 verified channels。
capabilities.proof: incremental client/server, protected-flight, wire-derived and accepted-transport tests
capabilities.limits: 调用方仍拥有 socket/transport；无浏览器级 HTTPS、外部 H2 或在线互操作完成声明。

capabilities.label: Runtime compatibility and startup profiles
capabilities.summary: Runtime marker、profile catalog 与公共 runtime surface。
capabilities.proof: runtime marker and startup-profile catalog tests
capabilities.limits: 描述当前运行时适配信息，不等于多平台运行证明。
